postfoundationscrisis.name: Post-Crisis: Applied Limits
postfoundationscrisis.truth: Knowing the limits of formalization, what do we build?
postfoundationscrisis.qfep_connection: After the foundations crisis, these maps explore what happens when incompleteness, bias, and rhizomatic thinking become design materials rather than problems to solve.
postfoundationscrisis.description: The sequence that lands the thesis. The foundations crisis showed that every formal system has an outside. These maps walk what becomes possible once you stop demanding completeness: ethics as architecture, paraconsistent engineering, situated computation, the commons as a response to incompleteness, rhizomatic networks, molecular design, and a synthesis that treats the edge as ground rather than limit.
learning_objectives: Algorithmic bias as structural incompleteness in classification systems
Ethics as the shape of the room, not a post-processing filter
Paraconsistent engineering — holding contradiction without collapse
Situated computation — knowledge always has a body, a place, a time
Collective knowledge and the commons as responses to incompleteness
Rhizomatic networks as non-hierarchical alternatives to tree structures
Molecular design as embodied formal systems
Synthesis: the edge is the ground, not the limit
content: PostCrisis_Synthesis: The Edge Is the Ground

deferred_reason.Chamber_PostFoundations: chambers removed from the spine (Palle, 2026-09-02): the catalyst chambers leave the walk; the map stays on disk

artifact_groups.rationale: Single artifact in divided room; spatial inequality of the architecture carries the lesson about bias
Three ethics-after-Gödel artifacts: the clipboard names the principles, the visualizer shows what classifiers miss, the room demonstrator shows that furniture layout is moral.
Paraconsistent logic as architecture: the merge-conflict junction holds two branches, the CAP triangle cycles trade-offs, Florensky's triptych refuses to resolve.
Two artifacts for placed knowledge: the sensor reports its own coordinates, the desk tags each claim with its source.
Three commons artifacts: the wiki gathers fragments, the ledger accumulates edits without overwriting, the citation graph shows that a claim's truth lives in its relations.
Single artifact in four-chamber rhizomatic cave; non-hierarchical layout enacts Deleuze/Guattari spatial logic
Single artifact on clean lab benches; molecular design as constructive post-reductionist practice

The spine's literal final artifact: raised central platform with rotating glass disc 'The edge is the ground' surrounded by seven stations, each recalling one prior map of the postfoundation arc. Thesis-landing closes here.
